read.thesis: Deutsche Telekom adds a EUR3bn buyback on top of the EUR2bn programme, lifting 2026 shareholder remuneration to almost EUR10bn; group FCF guidance raised to around EUR20bn while German fiber build is held at 2.5m homes.

capex.quote: We cannot accelerate at that point in time the fiber expansion.

triggers.label: Group FCF guidance raised to ~EUR20bn
triggers.quote: As a result, our group free cash flow guidance increased to around EUR20 billion.

triggers.label: Germany back-book +EUR2/month
triggers.quote: we have increased our price by EUR2 per month on the customer base.

triggers.label: Broadband subs down 20k in Q2
triggers.quote: you see that we basically lost 20,000 customers this quarter.

triggers.label: Eins & Eins cuts tariffs below EUR6.99
triggers.quote: The lowest price is this $6.99, you're correct. Effectively, let's say this is removing some tariffs below this price point.

guidance.quote: As a result, our group free cash flow guidance increased to around EUR20 billion.
We continue to guide for constant currency group EBITDA growth of around 6% to EUR47.5 billion in 2026.
We reiterate our DT ex US EBITDA guidance of EUR15.4 billion.
So the guidance, the full-year guidance of EUR11 billion EBITDA is fully intact.
